Why it works

Scams move fast. Blocklists don't.

Most scam pages are gone within hours, long before they reach a list. Sentinel looks at what a page is doing — pretending to be your bank, rushing you, locking your screen — and steps in at the moment it matters.

Privacy

Every check happens on your computer.

Sentinel doesn't send the pages you visit, the links you click or anything you type to anyone. Not to us, not to anyone else.

On device.

Scam detection runs entirely in your browser, even with Wi-Fi off.

Nothing typed is kept.

Sentinel can tell a card number from a phone number without saving either.

Free and open source.

Anyone can read exactly what it does.

Every page in this demo is a local fake. No real website is contacted.
